主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share of common stock for shareholders of record on January 24, 2014, with the dividend payable on February 21, 2014. This represents a 56.25% increase compared to the $0.32 per share paid in 2013. The announcement was made on January 13, 2014, and the full text of the press release is included as Exhibit 99.1. The information provided in the report is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless explicitly stated. The press release was issued as part of the Form 8-K filing, which is intended to be furnished and not deemed "filed" under the Exchange Act.
